data.name: Hardground
data.detailed_description:
Your grandfather has left you an old ranch far from the noise of city life. With a small amount of money, a lot of determination, and a clear goal in mind, you set out to transform the ranch into something more.

Purchase your first animals and care for them and they will pay you back in produce. Keep them healthy and happy and see as your ranch gradually grows while you breed animals, collect eggs, milk cows, and turn your produce into more valuable goods.

Build the ranch your way freely. Purchase vehicles to transport animals and supplies, then expand your operation as your income increases.

Life beyond the ranch has plenty to offer as well. Explore the countryside, complete quests, visit merchants, go fishing, hunt , forage for valueable items, and discover new ways to make money.

Every successful ranch begins with a simple plan. How far you take it is up to you.

Key Features

  • Raise and care for all kinds of animals.

  • Manage your animals and care for them to make them happy.

  • Collect and process more complex products.

  • Grow crops.

  • Design and expand your ranch with a flexible building system.

  • Transport animals and supplies using different vehicles fully physically there is no inventory.

  • Fish, hunt, forage, explore, and complete quests to boost your income, but the animals will always be the most profiteable.

  • Buy and sell goods to grow your wealth.

  • Build your property from a humble small ranch to a million-dollar business.

  • Explore a charming, colourful low-poly open world.

data.short_description: Inherit your grandfather’s neglected ranch and turn it into a thriving farming empire. Raise animals, grow crops, produce valuable goods and build your dream ranch. Explore the countryside, fish, hunt, complete quests, and work your way towards becoming a millionaire.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10 64-bit (version 21H1 or newer)
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-8400 or AMD Ryzen 5 2600
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 1060 3 GB or AMD Radeon RX 570 4 GB
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 5 GB available space
